#### RHubCreateDrill  
  
Create an Availability Zone Down drill template to validate the resiliency of the application via a simulated outage.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Improved outage readiness  

**Impact:** High
  
For more information, see [ResiliencyInAzure/Goals and recommendations/AssignGoals.md at main · Azure/ResiliencyInAzure · GitHub](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2324915)
